text: Record the result of the first decision-sets backtest and revise docs/design/decision-sets.md from it. I ran 'athena backtest' on the real records: fail. (a) Supersession parse: 24 hits, 0 lacking a target, plus one hit the review's pass list did not expect: D11 'Revised ... superseded by D39' at line 322. It is a real, partial supersession, so the expected list was incomplete; decide whether partial revisions are 'amended_by' or 'superseded'. (b) The D87 signal (intervention did-work-themselves, class docs, threshold 2 jobs) found 0 jobs. The real interventions are class code: 20261013-192156-ar1x (job 9h2j, the hand squash of PR #41 after GitHub refused a merge commit with HTTP 405) is the only one after D87 was recorded; kn3q and qk2d predate it. Findings to design for: a host error that falsifies a decision's stated assumption must put it under review on the first occurrence, while soft signals such as friction need repeats; host errors need their own record (review F3), since today the 405 exists only in intervention prose; signal field values must be validated against the record vocabulary so a signal cannot name a class nobody records. Also add a signal from the BRIEF.md addendum '2026-10-14: Common sense over rigid rules': a rule that rejects work which does not go against the rule's stated intent is a failure signal for the rule. Write the backtest result into the design with the real ids. Design only.
